notes: PCI Express Rev 1.0 does not specify OTP / fuse content as a protocol concept. Practically, every PCIe silicon device must burn Vendor ID + Device ID + Revision ID + Class Code into ROM / OTP / metal-mask so that Configuration Reads to offsets 00h-0Bh return the correct identifiers immediately after PERST# deassertion (before any software-programmed register has been written). The optional Device Serial Number Capability (Section 5.12) is also typically OTP-equivalent.

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: Assigned by PCI-SIG to the silicon vendor.
Per-product identifier chosen by the vendor.
Base Class + Sub-Class + Programming Interface; identifies the device category.
Per-board subsystem identification (typically the integrator's IDs).
Some templates may be silicon-fixed; address/data values themselves are programmed at runtime.
